outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic combined with raw western blot images; no averaged-data plot is present, so the check does not apply.
Bar charts show single densitometry quantification values per antibody with no error bars, indicating these are not averages of replicates, so individual data points are not required.
Panel C is a heatmap; individual data points are not meaningful in this context and are exempt from the check.
Panel D consists of violin plots, which already display the full data distribution and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean ± SD (n=4) with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each condition, satisfying the requirement.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not an averaged-data plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel G is a scatter plot; individual points are inherently the data shown, so overlay of additional points is not applicable.
Panel H is a scatter plot of individual IP-MS experiments; individual points are already the plotted data.
Panel I is a PCA scatter plot where each point already represents an individual sample; no averaging is depicted.
Panel J shows PCA scatter plots (per tissue) where each point represents an individual sample; no averaging is depicted.
